title: Value of an input vertex
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $gs$ be a list of gates, let $x$ assign Boolean values to the $n$ inputs, and let $i$ be one of those inputs. The value at input vertex $i$ after applying $gs$ to $x$ is $x(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
